6. Implement iterative exec function with carefully designed loop invariant

naming-conventions.spec-function: spec fn gcd(a: nat, b: nat) -> nat

code-organization.section: 1. Spec function: gcd(a: nat, b: nat)
3. Proof: lemma_mod_mul_zero (implement as provided in homework)

file-structure-requirements.verification-block: All code must be inside `verus! { }` block

development-testing.note: Can write normal `#[test]` functions and use `cargo test` to verify implementations before attempting proofs
development-testing.pattern: Write tests first to ensure implementations work, then add proofs

verification-requirements.requirement: Both implementations must verify (should be trivial with lemmas)

signature.code: proof fn lemma_gcd_positive(a: nat, b: nat) requires !(a == 0 && b == 0), ensures 0 < gcd(a, b),

lemma-mod-mul-zero.note: This is provided in homework - implement exactly as shown

signature.code: proof fn lemma_gcd_divides(a: nat, b: nat) requires !(a == 0 && b == 0), ensures a % gcd(a, b) == 0, b % gcd(a, b) == 0,

lemma-gcd-divides.note: ⚠️ nonlinear_arith mode alone is NOT sufficient - must use lemmas manually

loop-invariant-pattern.requirement: ⚠️ Loop invariant is the TRICKY part, not the proof
loop-invariant-pattern.guidance: Loop invariants must relate to the post-condition in the `ensures` clause
Loop invariants do NOT inherit pre-conditions - must state explicitly

critical-constraints.constraint: ⚠️ nonlinear_arith mode is NOT enough for gcd proofs - must use lemmas manually
Must implement lemma_mod_mul_zero FIRST (Task 3) before lemma_gcd_divides
Loop invariant design is critical - must relate to post-condition
Implementations should be trivial to prove once lemmas are established

common-pitfalls.pitfall: ⚠️ Trying to use nonlinear_arith mode alone for gcd_divides proof (won't work)
Not using all required lemmas in lemma_gcd_divides
Loop invariant that doesn't relate to post-condition
Forgetting that loop invariants don't inherit pre-conditions
Overcomplicating implementations (they should be trivial with lemmas)

success-criteria.criterion: lemma_gcd_divides proof completes (using all required lemmas)
Iterative implementation verifies with proper loop invariant
All implementations return same value as spec
